coverage.authority: Current bound actor/device/key, original social.feed scope, expiry/context and current block state checked before prepare/dispatch/completion
coverage.originalStore: Original Social account/idempotency map owns prepared/rejected/completed follow intent; no new nonce ledger
coverage.recovery: Square follow and original notification commit once; cancelled Social completion retains prepared intent; cold reopen same body/key retry does not change Square bytes
coverage.independentFollowing: Follow/unfollow never creates contact/request; historical follow receipt cannot restore an explicitly unfollowed relationship
coverage.notifications: Square remains the sole new follow notification producer; no duplicate Social notification on normal or cold retry

limitations: Software authority fixtures and local store tests are not public/installed Wallet or real business acceptance.
